problem.heading: Freelancing is broken. We're here to fix it.
problem.vagueDesc: Scope drifts because expectations were never written down clearly.
problem.delayedDesc: Invoices sit unpaid for weeks while your bills keep coming.
problem.escrowDesc: Without escrow, either the freelancer or the client is always at risk.
problem.vagueFixDesc: Every project ships with a clear scope, deliverables, and milestones — approved by both sides before a single hour is billed.
problem.delayedFixTitle: Escrow releases the moment work is approved
problem.delayedFixDesc: Funds sit safely in escrow, then transfer instantly when a milestone is signed off. No net-30 chases.

problem.escrowFixDesc: Money is held in a neutral vault. Clients only pay for approved work; freelancers know the money is already there.
